kemiripan js dengan py yg gw tau :
js : py
1. function : function
2. let, var, const : tanpa tanda/cuma =
3. conditional statement (sama)
4. for/while loop (sama)
5. comparison (sama)
6. operator (mirip php, ada jga mirip py)
7. code block (sama)
8. indentation (sama)
9. array : list, dictionary
10. tipe data (termasuk boolean, string, int, float, dll sama)
11. console.log : print
12. alert (mirip print tapi khusus pop up website)
13. prompt : input
14. parseint mirip kyk py input(int("masukkan usia : "))
15. ${} : f-string
